snippet.title: Unusual 2-4 player co-op board game  - Them Bombs! Play with friends, spouse, girlfriend!
snippet.description:
Cooperative board game app for 2-4 players, where one of the players takes on the role of an Unexpected Hero and tries to disarm a bomb. The other players become the Expert Team who have access to the “Sure-Fire Defusal Manual”. Players can only use verbal communication to identify bomb modules and to guide the Unexpected Hero through the bomb defusal.

http://www.thembombs.com

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yellowdot.ThemBombsGP

App Store: https://apple.co/2EPwju2
